import json,re,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('products/services/maintainer-funded-docs/')
b=(base/'raw/opire-home.html').read_bytes()
page=b.decode()
decoder=json.JSONDecoder()
reward_lists=[]
for match in re.finditer(r'self\.__next_f\.push\(',page):
 try: entry,_=decoder.raw_decode(page[match.end():])
 except ValueError: continue
 if len(entry)<2 or not isinstance(entry[1],str): continue
 part=entry[1]
 key='"initialRewards":'
 if key in part:
  rewards,_=decoder.raw_decode(part.split(key,1)[1])
  reward_lists.append(rewards)
assert len(reward_lists)==1
previous=json.loads(Path('products/services/opire-reward-directory/result.json').read_text())
by_url={x['url']:x for x in previous['candidates']}
visible=[{'url': x['url'], 'title':x['title'], 'advertised':x['pendingPrice']} for x in reward_lists[0]]
assert visible and set(by_url)=={x['url'] for x in visible}
for x in visible:
 x['prior_disposition']=by_url[x['url']]['reasons']
report={
 'source':'https://app.opire.dev/home','capture_receipt':'TASK-179546616111','sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
 'observed_date_utc':'2026-11-23','rendered_rewards':visible,
 'prior_original_checks':'products/services/opire-reward-directory/result.json',
 'decision':'No new candidate in the three rendered entries. Prior issue findings are historical. No original issue was re-fetched and no patch was attempted.',
 'coverage_limit':'Only the server-rendered initialRewards array was evaluated. This does not establish coverage of any other entries or boards.',
 'reopen_if':'A previously unscreened original maintainer notice or updated original issue shows a live funded non-security deliverable with an offline acceptance criterion.',
 'commercial_evidence':'Directory amounts are advertised. No submission, acceptance or settlement was observed.'
}
p=base/'result.json'
p.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
assert json.loads(p.read_text())==report
print(json.dumps({'artifact':str(p),'matched_existing_candidates':len(visible),'sha256':report['sha256']}))
